title: Computer Game
statementMd:
Vasya’s elder brother Petya loves playing computer games. In one of his favourite computer games Petya reached the final level where a fight with the boss take place.

While playing the game Petya found spell scrolls and now he is about to use them. Let’s describe the way fighting goes on this level:

1) The boss has two parameters: $*max*$ — the initial amount of health and $*reg*$ — regeneration rate per second.

2) Every scroll also has two parameters: $*pow*_{*i*}$ — spell power measured in percents — the maximal amount of health counted off the initial one, which allows to use the scroll (i.e. if the boss has more than $*pow*_{*i*}$ percent of health the scroll cannot be used); and $*dmg*_{*i*}$ the damage per second inflicted upon the boss if the scroll is used. As soon as a scroll is used it disappears and another spell is cast upon the boss that inflicts $*dmg*_{*i*}$ of damage per second upon him until the end of the game.

During the battle the actions per second are performed in the following order: first the boss gets the damage from all the spells cast upon him, then he regenerates $*reg*$ of health (at the same time he can’t have more than $*max*$ of health), then the player may use another scroll (no more than one per second).

The boss is considered to be defeated if at the end of a second he has nonpositive ($≤ 0$) amount of health.

Help Petya to determine whether he can win with the set of scrolls available to him and if he can, determine the minimal number of seconds he needs to do it.

## Input

The first line contains three integers $*N*$, $*max*$ and $*reg*$ ($1 ≤ *N*, *max*, *reg* ≤ 1000$) –– the amount of scrolls and the parameters of the boss. The next $*N*$ lines contain two integers $*pow*_{*i*}$ and $*dmg*_{*i*}$ each — the parameters of the $*i*$-th scroll ($0 ≤ *pow*_{*i*} ≤ 100$, $1 ≤ *dmg*_{*i*} ≤ 2000$).

## Output

In case Petya can’t complete this level, output in the single line `NO`.

Otherwise, output on the first line `YES`. On the second line output the minimal time after which the boss can be defeated and the number of used scrolls. In the next lines for each used scroll output space-separated number of seconds passed from the start of the battle to the moment the scroll was used and the number of the scroll. Scrolls are numbered starting from 1 in the input order. The first scroll is considered to be available to be used after $0$ seconds.

Output scrolls in the order they were used. It is not allowed to use scrolls after the boss is defeated.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

Vasya 的哥哥 Petya 喜欢玩电脑游戏。在他最喜欢的电脑游戏之一中，Petya 已经到达了最终关卡，这一关需要与首领进行战斗。

游戏过程中，Petya 找到了若干法术卷轴，现在他准备使用它们。下面介绍这一关的战斗方式：

1) 首领有两个参数：$*max*$ —— 初始生命值；$*reg*$ —— 每秒的生命恢复量。

2) 每个卷轴也有两个参数：$*pow*_{*i*}$ —— 以百分比表示的法术强度，即允许使用该卷轴时首领相对于初始生命值的最大生命值比例（也就是说，如果首领当前生命值超过初始生命值的 $*pow*_{*i*}$%，则无法使用该卷轴）；以及 $*dmg*_{*i*}$ —— 使用该卷轴后每秒对首领造成的伤害。卷轴一经使用就会消失，同时会在首领身上施放一个法术，直到游戏结束，该法术每秒对首领造成 $*dmg*_{*i*}$ 点伤害。

战斗中，每秒按以下顺序执行操作：首先，首领受到所有已施放法术造成的伤害；然后恢复 $*reg*$ 点生命值（同时其生命值不会超过 $*max*$）；之后玩家可以使用另一个卷轴（每秒最多使用一个）。

如果在某秒结束时，首领的生命值小于等于 0（$≤ 0$），则认为首领已被击败。

请帮助 Petya 判断他是否能使用手中的卷轴获胜；如果可以，求出击败首领所需的最少秒数。

## 输入格式

第一行包含三个整数 $*N*$、$*max*$ 和 $*reg*$（$1 ≤ *N*, *max*, *reg* ≤ 1000$）——卷轴数量以及首领的参数。接下来的 $*N*$ 行中，每行包含两个整数 $*pow*_{*i*}$ 和 $*dmg*_{*i*}$，表示第 $i$ 个卷轴的参数（$0 ≤ *pow*_{*i*} ≤ 100$，$1 ≤ *dmg*_{*i*} ≤ 2000$）。

## 输出格式

如果 Petya 无法完成这一关，单行输出 `NO`。

否则，第一行输出 `YES`。第二行输出首领被击败所需的最少时间，以及使用的卷轴数量。接下来的每一行中，对于每个使用的卷轴，输出从战斗开始到使用该卷轴时经过的秒数，以及卷轴编号，两者以空格分隔。卷轴按照输入顺序从 1 开始编号。第一个卷轴视为在经过 0 秒后即可使用。

按卷轴的使用顺序输出它们。首领被击败后，不允许再使用卷轴。
